correctness.rationale: Independently reconstruct largest-summand argument for each product-bounded competitor B: b>(q/k), product R of k−1 remaining distinct primes satisfies P_{k−1}≤R<kM; hence k≤Λ(M), remaining sum u≤R<H. As 0<s≤M<H, |b−q|=|s−u|<H, so isolation forces b=q; minimality and UFD yield B=A∪{q}. Handles k=1, singleton A, q∉A, strict window. PNT applied to primorials gives Λ(M)~log(M)/log log(M). Independently recalculated Λ(2)=2, Λ(3)=3, Λ(285)=5; finite checks do not establish theorem.
